delivery.rule: A delivery promise is only a data point if the page PRINTED the zip we requested. verified:false rows never enter the heatmap.
delivery.basis: One capture run per city with a pinned session; the zip is set through each retailer's own control and every row re-reads the zip the page printed. Only rows whose printed zip matches enter this table.
